title: The 10 elements
caught in
the rain
tag_line: Tag the one who never brings an umbrella.

items.Yang Wood: Shares the umbrella. Gets one shoulder soaked.
items.Yin Wood: Foldable umbrella in every single bag.
items.Yang Fire: Runs for it. Laughing the whole way.
items.Yin Fire: Waits it out with a hot Milo. Happily.
items.Yang Earth: Checked the weather app at 7am. Obviously.
items.Yin Earth: Has spare umbrellas for the whole office.
items.Yang Metal: Rain or not, leaves at 6 sharp. Walks fast.
items.Yin Metal: Won't step out till the shoes are safe.
items.Yin Water: Loves it. Window seat, rain playlist on.
